name: HomeLoop
summary: Evaluates a VLM-driven home robot coordinating with cameras, IoT devices and wearables on evolving household hazards and faulty sensors, where the same alert can have different causes. Temporal-logic checks score the outcome and every intervention, prohibited and missed.
numbers: 20 tasks, 5 families, 6 VLMs; best 61.9%; prohibited interventions outnumber missed required ones more than 2:1

why.cx: Multi-room episodes with evolving hazards and networked devices.
why.cog: Must diagnose an alert's cause before acting.
